label: Thought, in affirming or denying, is…, from Excluded middle as a general principle… and 1 more
meaning: Bridge (#401): excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE) and truth by composition, *Metaphysics* IV.7, 1011b26-27 with 1012a4-5 (STMT-THOUGHT-TRUE-OR-FALSE-BY-COMPOSITION), entail the second half of the thought argument on its universal reading, 1012a2-4 (STMT-AFFIRMING-OR-DENYING-THOUGHT-IS-TRUE-OR-FALSE): every thought that affirms or denies is true or false. Four cases: affirmation or denial, and its object holding or not. This makes exact why reading B begs the question against the intuitionist withholder (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-WITHHELD-INTUITIONISM): given composition, excluded middle for the objects of thought is what the sourced half needs.
